row.evidence: Canny's OneLogin guide says "OneLogin is only available on the Business plan in Canny" and has admins "click the Generate SCIM Token button and copy the SCIM Bearer Token"; the pricing page lists SSO integrations under Business ("Let's talk").
row.notes: New row. Flat plans: Free $0 (5 managers), Pro from $79/mo billed yearly (10 managers), Business custom. All IdP integrations (Okta, OIDC, Entra ID, OneLogin, Google Workspace admin management) are Business-only. SCIM exists only through Canny's OneLogin app (SCIM bearer token, OIDC sign-in, role via 'Set Role (SCIM)'); with one IdP this would be partial, but the price gate comes first, so gated. Entra ID and Google Workspace are Canny-run syncs that add admins and remove offboarded users; Okta and generic OIDC are sign-in with JIT only. No generic SCIM endpoint is documented. The public REST API (all plans) manages feedback end-users, not admin teammates.

roles.how: OneLogin rule action 'Set Role (SCIM) in Canny' with a macro matching a Canny role label (Owner, Manager, Contributor or a custom role); blank defaults to Owner.

limitations.text: SCIM is only documented for the OneLogin app; Okta and OIDC are sign-in with JIT, Entra ID and Google Workspace use Canny-run syncs.
An invalid role value means the user is not provisioned; a blank role defaults to Owner.
Provisioning Owner/Manager seats can change the bill.

scim.notes: No public SCIM base URL, schema or endpoint reference; the token only plugs into Canny's OneLogin catalogue app.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Documented event types cover posts, comments and votes; no user or admin events listed.

rate_limits.text: Per API key: Business 20 req/s, 600/min, 15,000/h; lower on Pro and Free.

limitations.text: The users API manages end-users who leave feedback (isAdmin is read-only on the user object); there is no documented endpoint to invite, remove or change the role of admin teammates.

okta.notes: OIN app marks only OIDC (read from page markup); Canny's Okta guide describes OIDC client ID/secret sign-in with JIT.

entra.notes: Configured from Canny's own Entra ID settings page by connecting a Microsoft account; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (canny-tutorial 404). Sync mechanism is not described.

google.notes: Canny imports selected Google groups weekly and revokes access when Google reports a deleted user.

onelogin.notes: From Canny's OneLogin guide; OneLogin's connector page was not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace group import (weekly) and Entra ID admin sync, both Business-only and run by Canny
fallbacks.notes: Okta, OIDC and OneLogin sign-ins create the account on first login and send an admin invite to confirm the email.
